lots.title: Provision of Asbestos Surveys Services
lots.description: Single-lot Service Specification for Lot 3 of the London Borough of Bexley Building Services Framework 6278, covering the provision of Asbestos Surveys across the Council's operational estate. The Supplier is to provide all expertise, staff, labour, materials, equipment and resources to deliver Management, Refurbishment, Demolition and sampling-only surveys in accordance with the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (enforced 2025) and HSE Guidance HSG264 (2025 update). The contract period is stated as 3 + 2 years commencing April 2026. The specification also scopes Asbestos Management Consultancy (specification/tender preparation), Asbestos Consultancy (contractor supervision and project control), ad-hoc Air Monitoring (Background, Leak, Reassurance, Stage Clearance and Personal) and training of Council staff and partner suppliers. Annual resource schedules are driven by Appendix B - Bexley Asbestos Surveys - Price Matrix and the associated Building List in Appendix 1. Deliverables, invoicing, risk assessments and work orders are mediated through the Council's TF Cloud (Civica) CAFM / Asset Management system. The Supplier must be UKAS-accredited for Asbestos Surveys and Analysis (ISO 17025 laboratories), maintain full H&S compliance, DBS-checked personnel, collaborate with the Council's FM Mechanical & Electrical, Lift, Fire Risk Assessment and Water Risk Assessment suppliers, produce RAG-prioritised Material Assessment reports (HSG264 algorithm, plus HSG227 Priority Assessments where required), and report all near-misses including RIDDOR-reportable incidents.
requirements: Deliver Management, Refurbishment, Demolition surveys and sampling-only services in accordance with HSG264 (2025 update) and the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (enforced 2025).
Carry out Refurbishment Surveys as fully intrusive inspections prior to refurbishment works, with destructive inspection as required to access all areas.
Carry out Demolition Surveys as fully intrusive inspections of all buildings prior to demolition (previously known as type 3 asbestos survey).

Carry out Management Surveys to locate ACMs that could be damaged or disturbed during normal occupancy or standard maintenance (previously type 1/2); access risers, loft areas, voids above suspended ceilings, representative carpet tiles and external areas.
Provide Sampling Services to collect and analyse samples from materials and locations specified by the Council where no full survey is required.
Analyse all asbestos samples at UKAS-accredited laboratories operating to ISO 17025; include the full laboratory certificate in the survey report.
Produce a Material Assessment Algorithm per HSG264 (High / Medium / Low / Very Low) for every ACM; include Priority Assessments per HSG227 where required.
Take at least two samples per surface for textured coatings in every property in line with HSG248 (2022 amendment).

Prepare annual resource schedule of Asbestos Surveys with the Council, mapped to the Building List (Appendix 1) and Price Matrix (Appendix B), distinguishing statutory compliance from best-practice activity.
Provide Asbestos Management Consultancy including drafting specifications, method statements, and tender / technical documentation for removal works and obtaining sign-off from the Council.
Provide Asbestos Consultancy Services including project supervision, planning, on-site attendance through removal phase and oversight of 4-stage clearance, smoke-tests and final clean.

Deliver Ad-hoc Air Monitoring services covering Background, Leak, Reassurance, Stage Clearance (Certificate of Reoccupation) and Personal monitoring, including mandatory monitoring in schools and libraries even for non-licensed work.
Train Council staff and partner suppliers on Control of Asbestos Regulations, related codes of practice and emerging regulatory change.
Operate via Council's Technology Forge (TF Cloud) CAFM / Asset Management system for work instructions, updates, documentation upload and invoicing; do not accept or invoice work outside the system.
Submit invoices monthly and only via electronic submission to fmcu.buildingservices@bexley.gov.uk; all jobs on an invoice must be fully documented before payment.

Provide full plant, equipment, PPE and RPE at Supplier expense, including access equipment to >4m heights (subject to prior Council approval for additional costs) and specialist confined-space equipment.
Submit Risk Assessment and Method Statements (RAMS) and a Dynamic Risk Assessment prior to every planned or reactive visit; submit in format compatible with TF Cloud upload.
Maintain a single point of contact for all H&S matters; report all near-misses and RIDDOR-reportable incidents to the Council.
Maintain formal training and assessment records for all operatives and submit annually to the Council; all senior staff to have excellent written and verbal English.
Operate stringent sub-contractor vetting including DBS checks; all sub-contractors subject to prior Council approval; monitor sub-contractor KPIs, spot checks and management meetings.
Presume presence of ACMs in plant rooms and appliances unless proven otherwise; never disturb or remove ACMs without Council agreement.
Keep Council premises secure, report lost keys immediately, maintain a designated key-holder and comply with site 'No Smoking' environment.

Attend monthly operational meetings and quarterly Contract performance partnership meetings; provide monthly / quarterly / annual performance, asset, risk, staffing and financial reports in Council-agreed format.
Provide a named representative / Contract Manager to oversee service delivery and a designated Authorised Person under H&S regulations.
Deliver mobilisation activities including IT / reporting system configuration, reports format, meeting schedule, KPI agreement and Asbestos Surveys programme agreement.
Submit a complaints procedure as part of the tender; record complaints, acknowledge to Contract Administrator within 24 hours, and rectify within agreed SLAs.
Commit to continuous improvement and innovation proposals, adherence to the Council's Environmental Policy (Appendix C) and Social Value objectives (Section 25).
Cooperate with the Council's appointed FM M&E/Building Fabric, Lift, Fire Risk Assessment and Water Risk Assessment suppliers, including joint intrusive-access visits for fire compartmental surveys.
Ensure all operatives can be identified on site, carry company ID cards, sign in/out per Council process and adhere to Council confidentiality and staffing policies.

Record per ACM: sample number, date surveyed / analysed, location, building product, accessibility, asbestos type(s), extent/quantity, condition, surface treatment, Material Assessment score, Priority Assessment score, overall Risk score, recommendation, laboratory certificate number, test results.
Include Laboratory Analyst's signed reports with site, dates, sample references and material identification; record negative results explicitly as 'No Asbestos Detected'.

warnings.message: The specification enumerates scope areas (asbestos consultancy, air monitoring, training, etc.) but does not publish numeric evaluation weightings or scoring bands in this document. Weightings are expected to live in the tender Invitation to Tender (Schedule 3) which is not present here. Evaluation criteria have been extracted as qualitative capability areas without weighting_text.
No CPV codes are cited in the tender specification body. CPV classification must be sourced from the parent notice metadata rather than from this document.

The specification states a '3 + 2 years' contract commencing April 2026, but detailed pricing and durations are governed by Appendix B (Price Matrix) and Appendix 1 (Building List), which are referenced but not embedded in this extraction.

Docling extracted the document as a single logical page (page_count=0 in the extraction row, all sections marked page_start=1). Page references in evidence anchors are therefore recorded as 'page 1' and rely primarily on section_ref for granular location.

This document is the Service Specification for Lot 3 of Framework 6278 only. A single authoritative lot (lot_number = 3) is emitted; it does not define or supersede Lots 1, 2, 4-11 of the parent framework.
